decisive_items: distal aspect of the thumb stump
response.rationale: Recurrent indurated skin lesion on a sun-exposed site with regional nodal metastasis is most consistent with squamous cell carcinoma; Merkel cell carcinoma is less common and typically more rapidly growing, while melanoma lacks pigmentary features here.

rejected.why: No pigmentation or atypical melanocytic features described; less specific for melanoma.
Merkel cell carcinoma is rarer and usually presents as a rapidly growing red/violaceous nodule; the indolent recurrence and firm induration favor SCC.
